question: Is the one supreme power truly divided by resorting to six thrones?
premises: The power is affirmed as one and supreme.
The power is described as resorting to six thrones.
The speaker questions whether this constitutes real division.
inference: The question is whether resorting to six thrones implies real division of the one supreme power.
plain_english: Is the one supreme power divided, resorting to six thrones?
